title: CanarioLand
description: CanarioLand: A complete Canarian culture overhaul. Craft Gofio, farm Acid Peppers, and use corrosive Salfumant weaponry to survive with the power of the Islands.
body:
🌾 Gastronomy & Tradition: Gofio

The Power of Gofio: Experience the ultimate Canarian superfood. Harvest grain, toast it, and mill it to create Gofio, a high-saturation food source that gives you the strength needed for long adventures.

Traditional Recipes: Craft different variants of Gofio to obtain unique buffs and restore your hunger quickly.

🧪 Chemical Warfare: Salfumant System

Acid Decomposition: A devastating new status effect. It causes armor-piercing damage, blindness, nausea, and extreme weakness.

Salfumant Bottles: Throwable projectiles that explode on impact, leaving a persistent toxic cloud that dissolves anyone who steps in.

Corrosive Arrows: Specialized ammo that injects acid directly into enemies, showing green trail particles and bypassing basic defenses.

🌿 Advanced Agriculture

Acid Peppers: A custom-rendered crop. It’s not just food; it’s the biological base for your chemical arsenal.

Canarian Flora: New plants and crops that bring the essence of the islands' landscape to your Minecraft world.

⚙️ Technical Features

Full Automation: Complete support for Dispensers (both bottles and arrows).

Vanilla Integration: Custom arrows are compatible with all vanilla bows and enchantments like Infinity.

Immersive Visuals: Custom entity renders and particle effects for a professional modding experience.

"In CanarioLand, tradition meets corrosion. Eat your Gofio, grab your Salfumant, and conquer the archipelago!"


*CREATED BY: TONI AND FROID  PROGRAMING WITH INTELLJ WITH NEOFORGE*
